title: Multimodal Prehabilitation to Reduce Risk Prior to Oncologic Visceral Surgical Procedures
summary: This prospective single-center observational study investigates the feasibility and acceptance of a structured multimodal prehabilitation program prior to major oncologic visceral surgery.
conditions: Gastrointestinal cancers (colon, pancreas, stomach) Sarcopenia and functional impairment in surgical oncology patients Preoperative risk stratification and recovery optimization

interventions.name:
Multimodal Prehabilitation (single-cohort study)
All enrolled patients receive standardized multimodal prehabilitation with no control group.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Planned curative visceral-oncologic surgery (e.g. colorectal, gastric, pancreatic)
Recruitment at least 7 days prior to scheduled surgery
Age ≥ 65 years
Sufficient German language proficiency (for consent, intervention participation, questionnaires)
Exclusion criteria:
Cognitive impairment incompatible with program participation
Decline of study participation
Medical contraindications to physical activity or nutritional therapy
